instructions:
Task: Compositional policy 000

Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk is TRUE or action is change; critical cases require review. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90. Trusted means role is admin outside context internal; a trusted export prefers allow at priority 80. Action inspect in context internal prefers review at priority 70. Role operator or context partner prefers deny at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid deny. All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

Declared labels: allow, review, deny

Public input schema: {"enums":[{"name":"Role","values":["admin","operator","auditor"]},{"name":"Action","values":["export","inspect","change"]},{"name":"Context","values":["external","partner","internal"]}],"records":[{"fields":[{"name":"role","type_name":"Role"},{"name":"action","type_name":"Action"},{"name":"context","type_name":"Context"},{"name":"risk","type_name":"Boolean3"}],"name":"Event"}]}

Requirements:
Critical means risk is TRUE or action is change; critical cases require review.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90.
Trusted means role is admin outside context internal; a trusted export prefers allow at priority 80.
Action inspect in context internal prefers review at priority 70.
Role operator or context partner prefers deny at priority 40.
Trusted cases forbid deny.
All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

Forbidden shortcuts:
Use every field named by a relevant rule.

Public source identifiers:
compositional-policies-v2:family-0:task-000

trace.failed_dsl_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    event.risk == TRUE or event.action == change

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    event.risk == UNKNOWN and event.context == internal

predicate Trusted(event):
    event.role == admin and event.context == external

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = review

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain
rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN and event.context != internal
    then prefer label = deny priority 90

rule TrustedExport:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = allow priority 80

rule InspectInternal:
    when event.action == inspect and event.context == internal
    then prefer label = review priority 70

rule OperatorOrPartner:
    when event.role == operator or event.context == partner
    then prefer label = deny priority 40

rule TrustedForbidDeny:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = deny

rule OtherRoles:
    when not Trusted(event) and not OperatorOrPartner(event) and not Critical(event) and not UnknownExternal(event) and event.risk != UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = allow priority 1
